name: pydantic
scope: JSON structure and values from local UTF-8 bytes; valid nested object and nested array controls
family_note: Pydantic TypeAdapter[Any].validate_json invokes pydantic-core SchemaValidator.validate_json. Pinned pydantic-core src/validators/mod.rs calls jiter::JsonValue::parse_with_config. The native extension is source-built with Rust LLVM coverage; Jiter parse.rs source regions, rather than Python wrapper lines, are required. Shares the Jiter parser family with the standalone jiter lead.

name: orjson
